Reject reviewed evidence on bound-episode mismatch while preserving raw review_provenance for audit.

provenance_schema.optionality: Fields are optional where evidence is absent; missing evidence is not synthesized by the production adapter.

adapter_behavior.reviewed_event_time_rule: Strict temporal use requires explicit validated_by_review, episode_specific, passed neighboring-alert check and event time inside the bound target episode; validated episode relation is a separate reviewed temporal evidence type.
adapter_behavior.publication_time_rule: publication/message/update times remain metadata and are never converted into event time.
adapter_behavior.rematch_rule: If persisted matched_episode_id is non-empty and differs from review_provenance.target_episode_id, reviewed provenance is unusable for classification; the provenance object remains preserved.
adapter_behavior.negative_rule: temporal.status in unsupported/ambiguous/negative never yields positive temporal proof.
adapter_behavior.composition_rule: Generic candidates retain the existing retrospective/publication-gap/neighbor guards. A reviewed cross-source pair may bypass generic publication-proximity/retrospective filters only when review_provenance names the exact target episode and exact contributor IDs, marks the pair validated_by_review and same_attack_compatible, and records a passed neighboring-alert check; publication time remains metadata and is never treated as event time.
